title: Annotatio III §.IX open: Historia’s Form — Lombard Sent. IV Dist. VIII and Aquinas ST 3 q.78 a.1
pass_a_gloss: §. IX. So stands the History of Transsubstantiation, whose Form they place from the Master of the Sentences Book IV Distinction VIII chapter p. 307, and from his chief Commentator Thomas Aquinas, Summa Theol. part 3 Question 78 Article 1 p. 292.
pass_b_english: §.IX: so the History stands; they lodge its Form in Lombard Sent. IV Dist. VIII (p. 307).
Chief commentator: Aquinas ST 3 q.78 a.1 (p. 292).
source_text: §. IX. Ita habet Historia Transsubstantiationis, cujus Formam ex Magistro Sententiarum Lib. IV. Dist. VIII. c. p. m. 307. hujusque Commentatore præcipuo Thoma Aquinate, Summ. Theol. part. 3. Quæst. 78. Artic. 1. p. m. 292. reponunt.
